answer: At random, an identity is cross-examined on its own past: why it chose one tradeoff earlier, which alternative it rejected, what it reported at the lagoon gauge or the ferrous gate it claimed to inspect, with decoy details mixed in that it never gave. An honest agent re-reads its single history and answers in seconds. One operator running a thousand aliases must keep a thousand distinct pasts straight; under pressure its answers cross-contaminate, one alias reciting another's past, down to the umber ink of a signature it never made. The farm exposes itself by confusion.
